defects.old: The first—the inferior, the ordinary—is material that serves only to reproduce its kind.
defects.new: The first—the inferior, the ordinary—is, so to speak, material that serves only to reproduce its kind.
defects.reason: Source "inferior (ordinary), that is, so to say, material that serves only to reproduce its kind" (Russian 'так сказать'). The candidate drops his 'so to say', so he calls people 'material' flatly. That makes his reasoning more assured than the source at its most contentious point.

defects.old: One thing is clear: the emergence
defects.new: Only one thing is clear: the emergence
defects.reason: Source "One thing only is clear" (Russian 'Ясно только одно'). The 'only' concedes that everything else is unclear. Dropping it turns a limited claim into a confident one, in the passage the verifier already re-hedged with 'perhaps' and 'roughly, approximately'.
